thread:
anya: Quick check-in  proposing tiny IA tweak: group left rail into Workspace / Deployments / Models / Observe. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/rail-brief

kevin: OK. Main ask: deep links should open canonical resource URLs and show clear breadcrumbs.

jamal: agree. We'll keep router path contract like /w/:wsSlug/models/:modelId/v/:verId and map patterns to nav IDs so the rail expands predictably.

olivia: UX rule: on deep-link landing focus the page H1, not the rail. Rail may expand visually but keyboard focus stays in content; provide a skip-to-nav link.

ada-a11y: +1. Also add an aria-live polite announcement for breadcrumb text after load and ensure share menu has aria-haspopup + keyboard support.

kevin: engineering: implement a small server-side redirect table for legacy query URLs -> canonical paths and a client navMap JSON for nav expansion. Preserve shareable query params (filters) but avoid ephemeral UI state in the path.

eng-bot: CI: nav-map spike branch created by kevin.

anya: action items: kevin spike redirects + navMap; olivia write breadcrumb copy and truncation rules; jamal spec analytics events (page.load_source); ada-a11y review ARIA copy. I'll update Figma and link tickets.
